description: token safety, rug check, contract risk score: Same scan as pacta_check_preflight at the latest block, plus a letter grade and a one-line summary; also takes a protocol slug (with an address only, start with pacta_who_controls_contract). Fast contract / token control-plane safety verdict: verdict, riskScore 0-100 and grade A-F (both null when not determined, e.g. NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND), a one-line verdict, upgrade / owner / pause / blacklist / mint capability flags, the controller (EOA, Safe threshold, timelock delay), the indexed Pacta record when there is one, and a shareable scan URL. One pinned block; Ethereum and Base. With no arguments it checks the built-in default (ethereum 0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D405200A15b). Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); x402 USDC on Base above quota. Shares the 100/day quota of /v1/x402/verdict; above it, call that route over HTTP with x402 ($0.02).

address.description: Checksummed or lowercase 0x + 40-hex contract address on ethereum or base when checking by chain + address; omit when slug is given (use either slug or chain + address, not both: HTTP and free-launch MCP reject conflicting inputs as bad_request; in x402_paid mode MCP returns payment_required and directs you to HTTP first).

chain.description: Target chain ("ethereum" or "base") when checking by chain + address; omit when slug is given (use either slug or chain + address, not both: HTTP and free-launch MCP reject conflicting inputs as bad_request; in x402_paid mode MCP returns payment_required and directs you to HTTP first).

slug.description: Optional lowercase-hyphen protocol slug (https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json); or pass chain + address (not both; omitting all checks ethereum 0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D405200A15b on free-launch MCP or paid GET, and returns the 402 challenge on unpaid GET).
